guard: with two live remote managers for one owner, every manager-caller surface can name an instance, a managed seat defaults to its spawner, and the refusal lists the candidates with the caller's own remedy
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/runtime build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm smoke:manager-run-owned-agents
why: #3959: the auth service refuses an unpinned manager-caller exchange when an owner has two live
remote managers, and `cotal models`, the hosted `cotal run` verbs and MCP `cotal_run` and
`cotal_personas` had no way to name one. Each mutation drops one forwarded instance, or the
seat's spawner default, or the per-caller remedy, and the cell for that surface goes red.
The command rebuilds every package a mutation edits, so one green baseline covers all six.

mutations.name: cotal models drops --on before the manager-caller exchange
mutations.expectRed: #3959 `cotal models --on <instance>` succeeds against the named instance
mutations.cell: #3959 `cotal models --on <instance>` succeeds against the named instance

mutations.name: cotal run drops --on before the manager-caller exchange
mutations.find: const t = seat?.mode === "auth" ? seat : await resolveControlTarget(values, "control-caller-privileged", on);
mutations.replace: const t = seat?.mode === "auth" ? seat : await resolveControlTarget(values, "control-caller-privileged");
mutations.expectRed: #3959 `cotal run ps --on <instance>` succeeds against the named instance
mutations.cell: #3959 `cotal run ps --on <instance>` succeeds against the named instance

mutations.name: MCP cotal_run ps drops its instance argument
mutations.find: const reply = await agent.run("ps", { endpoint: a.endpoint }, a.instance);
mutations.replace: const reply = await agent.run("ps", { endpoint: a.endpoint });
mutations.expectRed: #3959 MCP cotal_run ps with instance succeeds against the named instance
mutations.cell: #3959 MCP cotal_run ps with instance succeeds against the named instance

mutations.name: MCP cotal_personas list drops its instance argument
mutations.expectRed: #3959 MCP cotal_personas with instance reads the named instance's catalog
mutations.cell: #3959 MCP cotal_personas with instance reads the named instance's catalog

mutations.name: a managed seat's shell ignores the manager that launched it
mutations.expectRed: #3959 a managed seat's own `cotal run ps` defaults to its spawner
mutations.cell: #3959 a managed seat's own `cotal run ps` defaults to its spawner

mutations.name: the ambiguity refusal names the wire field for every caller
mutations.expectRed: #3959 unpinned `cotal models` refuses two live managers, lists both and names --on
mutations.cell: #3959 unpinned `cotal models` refuses two live managers, lists both and names --on
